description: This is a PHP source file defining the PreviewThemeAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for previewing theme variables in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating theme previews via POST requests and defines relevant API documentation annotations.

classes.name: PreviewThemeAPI
classes.description: Provides API endpoints to preview theme settings by accepting theme variables via POST and returning derived CSS variables.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to retrieve all theme previews.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to provide validation rules for retrieving all previews.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to generate a theme preview based on provided theme variables; returns a collection of CSS variables.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the create method.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to delete a theme preview.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to provide validation rules for deleting a preview.
